title: VTG The World of Ginny Vogue Dolls Sweet Rosebud 8" Poseable Vinyl Doll 1984 NIB
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: VTG The World of Ginny Vogue Dolls Sweet Rosebud 8" Poseable Vinyl Doll from 1984 is a vintage collectible doll with red straight hair, green eyes, and a light complexion. This original fashion doll comes with accessories and is part of the Dolls of the World product line by Vogue. The doll is 8 inches tall, suitable for children aged 3 years and older, and comes in its original packaging from Hong Kong. With its nostalgic charm and classic design, this Ginny Vogue doll is a timeless piece for any doll collector or enthusiast.
